meta.name: ceo-advisor
meta.description: Pressure-tests a decision, plan, or idea before it is committed to — surfacing the assumption it rests on, the case against it, and what would have to be true for it to work. Use this when weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, when you have already decided and want a genuine gut check, when processing meeting notes into decisions, or when competing initiatives need ranking. Distinct from `chief-executive`, which owns direction; this one interrogates a specific decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拍板前先给计划做次压力测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做关键决定前想听听反对意见
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a genuine challenge before making an important choice.

howto.what: 装上后，它会先帮你厘清真正要做的决策，再对计划做压力测试：找出关键假设、反对理由、依赖条件等，并直接指出问题。最后按固定格式给出：真实决策、一句话建议、关键假设、最强反对、改变推荐的因素、本周第一步。
howto.when: 当你在权衡多个选项、需要有人挑战计划、或已做决定但想要真实检验时触发；也可用于把会议纪要转成决策、给竞争项目排序等。

say.text: 帮我压力测试一下“下季度招三个销售”这个决定。
say.note: Claude会先厘清真正要决定的问题。

say.text: 两个项目在抢资源，帮我排出先后。
say.note: 会按约束条件强制给出顺序。

say.text: 我决定用A方案了，但想听反对意见。
say.note: Claude会先直接说最难听的话。

howto.what_en: Claude restates the real decision, stress-tests the plan (key assumption, dependencies, strongest counterargument, what it forecloses, half-success), says hard truths, ranks initiatives, checks past commitments, and returns a verdict.
howto.when_en: When you are weighing options, need a plan challenged before committing, or already decided and want a genuine gut check; also when processing meeting notes into decisions or ranking competing initiatives.

say_en.text: Pressure-test my decision to hire three salespeople next quarter.
say_en.note: Claude will first clarify the real question.

say_en.text: Two projects are competing for resources. Rank them.
say_en.note: Forces a strict order based on the binding constraint.

say_en.text: I've decided on Plan A, but I want to hear the case against it.
say_en.note: Claude will state the strongest objection first.
